description: This file is an extension for 'OnboardingView' providing asynchronous functions to manage workspace setup, configuration, and state refresh within the application.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceDefaults
methods.description: Initializes the workspace path based on saved configuration and refreshes bootstrap status.

methods.name: ensureDefaultWorkspace
methods.description: Ensures a workspace exists and is bootstrap safe, creating it if necessary, and updates status messages.

methods.name: refreshBootstrapStatus
methods.description: Updates the needsBootstrap flag based on current workspace URL resolution.

methods.name: workspaceBootstrapCommand
methods.description: Generates a shell command string for creating and populating workspace directory.

methods.name: applyWorkspace
methods.description: Creates the workspace if safe, updates the path and status, handling errors accordingly.

methods.name: loadAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current workspace configuration from stored data.

methods.name: saveAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Saves the specified workspace string asynchronously and updates status messages based on success or failure.

methods.name: buildAndSaveWorkspace
methods.description: A static method that updates the config store with a workspace path, handling errors during save.
